name: immich-mcp
description: Austrian efficiency for Immich photo management with FastMCP 2.11+ and GIMP integration. Search photos with natural language like 'dog at the beach at sunset' and edit with GIMP.

tools.name: upload_photos
tools.description: Upload photos to Immich with batch processing and metadata detection

tools.name: get_photo_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a photo including metadata

tools.name: search_photos
tools.description: Search photos using natural language queries (e.g., 'dog at the beach at sunset')

tools.name: server_health
tools.description: Check the health and status of the Immich server

tools.name: process_photos_batch
tools.description: Process multiple photos with GIMP for batch editing

tools.name: edit_photo_with_gimp
tools.description: Edit a photo using GIMP with specified operations

immich_url.title: Immich Server URL
immich_url.description: The base URL of your Immich server (e.g., http://localhost:2283 or https://immich.example.com)

immich_api_key.title: Immich API Key
immich_api_key.description: Your Immich API key (found in Immich settings under 'Account')

gimp_path.title: GIMP Executable Path
gimp_path.description: Path to GIMP executable (e.g., /usr/bin/gimp or C:\Program Files\GIMP 2\bin\gimp-2.10.exe)

log_level.title: Logging Level
log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (debug, info, warning, error, critical)
